subject: Re: Cross-stack architecture review — SocketLift PoC kickoff
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Kline <emma.kline@socketlift.com>, Rajiv Patel <rajiv.patel@payflow.io>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Cross-stack architecture review / PoC kickoff

Hi Emma / Rajiv —

Thanks again for the time today. Per our call, SocketLift is targeting a migration away from your current self-hosted inference stack (Kubeflow + custom shims) toward a managed inference runtime. We'd like to run a focused architecture review and technical deep-dive next week to:

- Validate request shape / latency SLOs for your highest-throughput routes
- Walk through prefix/KV cache integration and session affinity expectations
- Map data flow for telemetry, audit logs, and PIIs to meet your compliance needs
- Agree on PoC success criteria (latency targets, cost baseline, integration points)

Proposed slots (PST):
- Tue 2027-05-25 10:00–11:00
- Tue 2027-05-25 15:00–16:00
- Wed 2027-05-26 08:30–09:30

Attached: SocketLift-data-flow.pdf (diagram), poc-checklist.xlsx (draft PoC tasks).

If these don't work, tell me two windows that do and we’ll coordinate with engineering. I’ll bring Priyom (runtime engineer) and Grace (solutions architect).

Thanks,
Alex Martinez
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: SocketLift-data-flow.pdf (PDF), poc-checklist.xlsx (XLSX)

From: Emma Kline <emma.kline@socketlift.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rajiv Patel <rajiv.patel@payflow.io>, procurement@socketlift.com
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 19:04:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Cross-stack architecture review / PoC kickoff

Alex —

Appreciate the clear agenda. We are very interested in the PoC, but heads-up: our infra lead has an all-hands that afternoon on Tue 5/25 and won't be available for the 15:00 slot. The 10:00–11:00 window looks promising for most of the team, but can you confirm availability for 10:00 PST?

Also, two asks from our side before the call:
1) Can you share a lean agenda that calls out concrete artifacts we'll produce during the PoC?
2) Any red-team or compliance prep we should run ahead of time (SOC 2 snippets, sample audit logs)?

Looping in procurement for contract cadence.

—Emma
Emma Kline
Head of Platform Engineering
SocketLift
emma.kline@socketlift.com

Alex — forwarding Emma's response. Quick coordination note:

- Alex asked for Tue 5/25 10:00 PST. Priyom, Grace — can you confirm 10:00–11:00 on 5/25? If Priyom needs a morning buffer, propose Wed 5/26 08:30 PST as backup.
- I'll prepare a concise agenda doc for the session that includes: intro + goals (10m), request shape walkthrough (20m), caching & state/affinity (20m), integration checklist & PoC next steps (15m), Q/A (15m).
- I'll also attach a version of the agenda for Emma's ask on artifacts.

Priorities for the call: ensure we can show a concrete KV-cache integration plan and an example fallback policy to prevent latency spikes during autoscale.

Thanks — copying Alex.

—Lauren

Date: Sun, 23 May 2027 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Cross-stack architecture review — Confirmed: Tue 2027-05-25 10:00 PST

Emma / Rajiv —

Thanks for the quick reply and for looping procurement. We can confirm the Tue 25 May 10:00–11:00 PST slot. I've booked the session and attached the invite (socketlift-final-invite.ics) — please add to your calendars.

Call logistics:
- Date: Tue, 25 May 2027
- Time: 10:00–11:00 PST / 13:00–14:00 EST
- Zoom: https://zoom.redwood.ai/j/883-129-xxxx (passcode sent in calendar invite)
- Shared folder with artifacts: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/1a2b3c-arch-sync

Agenda (short):
1) Goals & success criteria (Alex, 5m)
2) SocketLift request shape & traffic profile (Emma, 15m)
3) Cache & session affinity options (Priyom, 20m)
4) Integration checklist + telemetry mapping (Grace, 15m)
5) PoC milestones & next steps (Lauren, 5m)

Pre-reads attached: redwood-arch-agenda-v2.md, poc-checklist.xlsx. Procurement — if you want a separate pre-call to discuss contract timing we can do 30m after the technical session; otherwise we'll include a brief timeline in the PoC next steps.

If anything changes on your side, ping me and we'll pivot. Looking forward.

—Alex
